sents.t: This winter, I started shopping online.
It’s easy: you choose, you click, and the package comes to your door.
Last week, I ordered new winter boots.
The website said, “Your order has shipped. It will arrive in three days.” The package came on Friday, but there was a problem.
I have never returned anything online before, so I asked Emma for help.
The website asked, “Why are you returning this item?” I chose “wrong size.” Then it gave me a free return label.
I printed it, put the boots back in the box, and took it to the post office.
Today I checked my email: “We have received your return, and we have sent your refund.”
I have ordered size ten this time, and I have read the reviews carefully.
“Have you ever ordered the wrong size?” I asked Rosa.
